svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each steady state, on a log scale beside a decode step on the RTX 5060 Ti of 16 to 20 ms, for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 1.1% of stock's in every state) and the change as deployed (adding 36 to 1,719 µs a step): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 326, 326 and 384 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 797, 799 and 886 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,789, 2,819 and 2,968 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,638, 1,648 and 1,684 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 678, 682 and 720 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 352, 355 and 894 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 792, 796 and 1,338 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,627, 2,646 and 3,271 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,640, 2,652 and 3,296 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,604, 1,622 and 3,340 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 187, 189 and 348 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 692, 693 and 875 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,444, 2,460 and 2,707 µs.
svg.text: Scheduler.schedule()'s wall time a step on the host (ms, log scale)
